description: environment.getProjectsByIdOrNameCustomEnvironments omits the 404 the live API returns when the project itself does not exist (code `not_found`, message "Project not found." — live-verified 2026-08-13). The custom-environment provider's parent fan-out `list` enumerates projects and lists each project's environments; a project deleted between enumeration and listing must surface as a typed NotFound so the fan-out can skip it.
